title: AI-SDLC DodConfig
description: Definition-of-Done gate config. Lives at .ai-sdlc/dod-config.yaml. The hard-enforced exit validation run before a task is marked Done / a PR opened: build + tests must pass and changed code must carry no incomplete-work markers. Counterpart to DorConfig (entry).

evaluationMode.description: enforce blocks Done on a failed enforced check; warn only reports.

checks.description: The exit checks. Every key other than markers/outcomes that carries a `command` (or `type: github-checks`) is a runnable check; all run concurrently. markers scans changed files.

outcomes.description: Advisory tier: point at a run-records JSONL to surface Level-1 outcome metrics (completion/regression/review-loops/blast-radius). Never blocks.

runRecords.description: Path (relative to project root) to the run-records JSONL.

concurrency.description: Max checks running at once. Default: all runnable checks concurrently.

type.description: command (default): run `command` in a shell, exit 0 = pass. github-checks: wait for the branch PR's CI checks (decision-engine/ci-checks.js).

command.description: Shell command; exit 0 = pass. Receives AI_SDLC_BASE and AI_SDLC_CHANGED_FILES.

enforced.description: If true (default), a failure blocks Done in enforce mode.

paths.description: Repo-relative globs (dir/, **, *, ?). The check is skipped when the changed set is known and no changed file matches.

timeoutMinutes.description: Kill the command (whole process group) / stop waiting for CI after this long.

push.description: github-checks: `git push -u origin HEAD` first (outward-facing; opt-in).

draftPr.description: github-checks: open a draft PR when the branch has none (CI on pull_request needs one; opt-in).

baseBranch.description: github-checks: base branch for the draft PR (default main).

appearTimeoutSeconds.description: github-checks: fail if no check appears within this long (default 300).
